description: Start a VibeFix check of the LIVE, published app: a real browser opens it as a brand-new person, signs up with a real inbox, follows the confirmation email, and uses the app on a phone and a computer. It finds what a coding assistant cannot see from the code or the preview: emails that never arrive, confirmation links that open the wrong site, buttons covered on a phone, dead first steps. Call it after any change to sign-up, log-in, onboarding or payments, ONCE THE CHANGE IS PUBLISHED (it checks the public address, not the preview). It takes a few minutes: this returns a check_id at once; then call get_check_result with it. IF THIS APP WAS ALREADY CHECKED, DO NOT CALL THIS AGAIN: call confirm_fix with that check_id instead. Every app gets one free check (one new app a day per account); re-checks after a fix are paid.
